title: PersonaFactor: Preference Factors with Dynamic Selection for LLM Personalization
abstract: arXiv:2610.16372v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Although users may express different personalization needs across tasks, these task-specific behaviors can reflect shared underlying preference mechanisms. Existing LLM personalization methods often focus on surface-level interactions or undifferentiated histories, overlooking the shared mechanisms underlying these behaviors. We introduce PersonaFactors, a framework that distills reusable and interpretable personalization factors from heterogeneous user interactions. We construct a library of thirteen PersonaFactors by extracting evidence-grounded rationales and clustering recurring patterns across tasks, and develop a dynamic factor-guided generation framework that selects factors relevant to each user's history and current request. Across four personalization benchmarks and four backbone models, Dynamic PersonaFactor achieves the best score on every reported metric. tldr: PersonaFactor框架从异构用户交互中提炼出十三个可复用、可解释的个性化偏好因子，并通过动态因子选择机制，在四个个性化基准和四个骨干模型的所有指标上均取得最佳性能。
en_tdlr: PersonaFactor distills thirteen reusable and interpretable personalization factors from heterogeneous user interactions and dynamically selects relevant factors for each request, achieving the best performance on every metric across four personalization benchmarks and four backbone models.
